prediction_question: For a Taiwan county on a date D for which a typhoon land warning (陸上颱風警報) is active or being considered, will offices and schools be fully closed (全日停止辦公及上課) on D, predicted at the statutory announcement instant on the evening before D?
prediction_time: The announcement instant is fixed by regulation, quoted from the DGPA daily closure page (2026-10-22) and repeated verbatim in the announcement attachments: full-day or morning closures must be announced between 19:00 and 22:00 the previous evening (前一日晚間7時至10時前發布); same-morning reinforced closures are announced by 04:30 and broadcast by 05:00. Features may therefore use only data published before 19:00 Taipei time on D-1 (CWA warning bulletins issued through 17:10/20:10 are the boundary cases and must be pinned per-bulletin by issuance timestamp).
target_definition: Binary per (county, date): the county's status for date D is a full-day stop of both work and school, as published by the Directorate-General of Personnel Administration (DGPA). Label sources (excluded from shipped features): the DGPA 歷次天然災害停止上班上課訊息 archive (500 announcements, 2001-present, per-county status attachments) and, for the modern era, county-portal historical CSVs (e.g. data.taipei 臺北市歷次天然災害停止上班上課訊息, fields 民國年/月/日/天然災害名稱/停止上班上課情形).

measurements.dgpa_archive_span_2026_10_22: DGPA archive: 500 announcements over 50 pages (10/page), oldest record 民國90.07.30 (CE 2001-07-30), newest 民國115.09.03 (CE 2026-09-02) - measured from informationlist pages 1 and 50, fetched anonymously 2026-10-22.
measurements.dgpa_fetch_sizes_2026_10_22: Detail page pid=13097 = 34,360 bytes; attachments 3,058-21,661 bytes; full harvest is about 50 list pages + 500 detail pages + 500-1000 attachments, on the order of 1,050-1,550 requests and 20-30 MB total (estimate labelled as such; not yet measured end-to-end). DGPA HTTPS fails strict SSL validation (chain missing Subject Key Identifier), so probes used an unverified context; the browser accepts the chain.
measurements.dgpa_attachment_formats_2026_10_22: Sampled first record of list pages 1/6/12/20/30/40/45: static per-county status table found for 2002 (Big5), 2009-era, and 2024-10-04 (UTF-8 typhoon-event table, 21,661 bytes); shell-only files (no county rows, only the statutory disclaimer block) observed for 2023-06-01, 2025-09-30 and 2026-09-02 - per-county extraction for the modern era is the one unproven step and is pinned as the first construction task.

next_action: Construction (coordinator-side scripts first, then worker): (1) PIN THE MODERN-ERA LABEL EXTRACTION - try DGPA daily-view query variants (the server-rendered /typh/daily/nds.html answers per-county statuses for the current day; find its historical-date parameterisation if any) and, in parallel, harvest the county-portal CSVs (data.taipei verified; Taichung and Taoyuan equivalents are listed as related datasets on data.gov.tw 20457); decision gate: if neither yields machine-readable per-county statuses for 2015-2026, re-target the label to announcement-day grain (which counties closed anywhere on date D, derivable from the archive alone). (2) Build the event panel: county-days within typhoon warning periods 2001-2026 from the DGPA archive plus CWA TDB bulletin issuance times. (3) Feature set strictly before 19:00 TPE D-1: CWA warning bulletins (position, central pressure, radius, forecast track distance to county centroid), previous-day closure status, county identity; assert no post-instant field enters shipped columns. (4) Report clustered positives at typhoon level, not row level. (5) Run the baseline triad (persistence = previous-day closure status, calendar-only, full model) before quoting any AUC.

prior_art: Taiwan civil typhoon-day predictor apps and hackathon projects (predict whether tomorrow is a typhoon day); no public benchmark dataset of the closure decision was found in any catalog
novelty_check.theirs: DGPA publishes the closure record (labels only, as human-readable announcement pages); CWA publishes forecasts and the typhoon database (features only); consumer apps and hackathon demos predict typhoon days but ship no dataset, no splits and no scored contract
novelty_check.ours: First ML-ready benchmark of the Taiwan county-day typhoon-closure decision: 2001-2026 panel built from the DGPA statutory announcement archive (the only public per-county closure record) with the prediction instant fixed by regulation at 19:00-22:00 the prior evening, features limited to CWA typhoon warning bulletins and prior-day closure status available before that instant, year-based splits with clustered positives reported per typhoon, and persistence/calendar baselines shipped beside any model
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
